basic_details.job_title: Calicut University Women Security Guard Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The University of Calicut will hold a physical test for its Women Security Guard walk-in on 20 November 2026 at 07.30 AM at Calicut University Stadium. The interview will follow on 21 November 2026 at 09.30 AM in the Syndicate Conference Hall, Administration block. The posts are for women only and are filled on a daily wage basis. Graduates who are not over 40 years as on 01.01.2026 can attend. The pay is ₹840 per day, with a maximum of ₹22,680 per month.

Women graduates not over 40 years as on 01.01.2026 who meet the physical standards

content_sections.heading: About the University of Calicut
content_sections.text: The University of Calicut issued this walk-in notice as a press and web release, signed by its Registrar, Beena C.K. The Women Security Guards will be engaged in the University on a daily wage basis. The physical test and the interview will both be held on the University's own premises.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The only post is Women Security Guard on a daily wage basis. Candidates must meet the educational, age and physical standards below. They must also qualify the physical test events. Graduation from any recognized University. The age should not exceed 40 years as on 01.01.2026. SC/ST/OBC candidates will be eligible for age relaxation as per rules. The notice does not give the number of years of relaxation. Candidates must be certified to meet the following visual standards without glasses: Each eye must have a full field of vision. Colour blindness, squint or any morbid conditions of the eye or lids of either eye are a disqualification. Candidates must be free from apparent physical defects like knock-knee, flat foot, varicose vein, bow legs, deformed limbs, irregular and protruding tooth, and defective speech and hearing. Candidates must qualify at least five of the following eight events: SPC/NCC Certificate Achievements in Sports/Games at District/University/State/National levels The wages are ₹840/- per day, with a maximum of ₹22,680/- per month. Engagement is on a daily wage basis. The notice does not mention any allowances. For the full eligibility conditions, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Certificates to prove name Certificates to prove age Certificates to prove community Certificates to prove qualifications Medical Certificate from a registered medical practitioner, in the prescribed format attached to the notice The medical certificate format is printed with the notice. The medical officer must certify that the candidate is medically fit for the Physical Fitness Test under Notification No. 195273/AD-K-ASST-1/2022/Admn for the post of Women Security Guard in the University of Calicut. The certificate also needs the place, date, the medical officer's signature, name and designation, and the office seal.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: a physical test and an interview. Report for the physical test at Calicut University Stadium on 20.11.2026 at 07.30 AM. In the physical test, qualify at least five of the eight events listed above. Only candidates who qualify the physical test will be permitted to attend the interview. The interview is on 21.11.2026 at 09.30 AM in the Syndicate Conference Hall, Administration block.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Calicut University Women Security Guard physical test?
faq.answer: The physical test is on 20 November 2026 at 07.30 AM at Calicut University Stadium.

faq.question: Q2. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 21 November 2026 at 09.30 AM in the Syndicate Conference Hall, Administration block. Only candidates who qualify the physical test can attend.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Women Security Guard post?
faq.answer: Candidates need graduation from any recognized University. They must also meet the height, eyesight and physical event standards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 40 years as on 01.01.2026. SC/ST/OBC candidates get age relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Calicut University Women Security Guard?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹840/- per day, with a maximum of ₹22,680/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring certificates proving your name, age, community and qualifications. Also bring a Medical Certificate from a registered medical practitioner in the prescribed format attached to the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by a physical test followed by an interview. Only candidates who qualify the physical test may attend the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How many events must I qualify in the physical test?
faq.answer: You must qualify at least five of the eight events. Examples include the 100 Meters Run in 17 seconds and Skipping 80 times in one minute.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets a relaxation?
faq.answer: SC/ST/OBC candidates get age relaxation as per rules. SC/ST candidates need a minimum height of 150 cm instead of 157 cm.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Women Security Guard job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on a daily wage basis, at ₹840/- per day with a maximum of ₹22,680/- per month.
